fields.label: Model
fields.help: With PaddleOCR configured this model receives text only and does not need vision.

fields.label: PaddleOCR token
fields.help: Enables external OCR. The token is stored only on the tablet; OpenAI then receives recognized text instead of the page image.

fields.label: OCR model
fields.help: PP-OCRv6 is the fast default. PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 remains supported for document-layout OCR.

fields.label: Speculative OCR
fields.help: On by default: submit after one second of idle time. Turn off to avoid possible extra paid jobs after a mid-sentence pause.

fields.label: API mode
fields.help: Responses enables model-managed tools such as web search.

fields.label: Reasoning effort
fields.help: Only for reasoning models. Low balances accuracy and first-ink latency.

fields.label: Background web search
fields.help: In Responses mode, MP searches quotations, provenance, current and uncertain facts in the background.

fields.label: Paper editor model
fields.help: Rare fallback that rewrites web/Markdown formatting as natural paper prose.

fields.label: Max tokens
fields.help: Runaway guard. Thinking models count hidden reasoning tokens against it — keep it roomy.

fields.label: MagicPaper remembers
fields.help: When on (default), MP keeps your pages on the tablet, follows the conversation, and "show me…" conjures past pages. "off" disables page memory.

fields.label: Recent dialogue turns
fields.help: Number of recent page/reply pairs carried as continuous conversation.

fields.label: Timezone offset
fields.help: Hours from UTC, so the dates of conjured memories read right.

fields.label: Recurring tasks
fields.help: On by default. Write a command such as 任务 每五分钟讲一个冷笑话 to add a persistent task.

fields.label: TODO list
fields.help: On by default. Write TODO followed by text to add an item; write TODO alone to open the list.

fields.label: Task retry delay
fields.help: Smart scheduling waits until the exact nearest due time without an API request. This controls only retries after delivery failure.
